# Gilded standards: four poles with gold finials and red pennants at the corners of a build pad and
# a gold band round its edge: a tower at level 3. Origin at the pad's centre. make_env.py.
new
material new Gold --base-color 0.7451 0.5843 0.3608 --no-slot
material new Pole --base-color 0.7451 0.5843 0.3608 --no-slot
material new Pennant --base-color 0.6039 0.3098 0.3137 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Pole0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.0800 0.0800 1.0500
apply --scale
translate 0.4243 -0.4243 0.5250
material assign Pole
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fin0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1000 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.4243 -0.4243 1.1000
material assign Gold
add mesh cube --name Flag0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2000 0.0500 0.2200
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -45.00
apply --rotation
translate 0.5162 -0.5162 0.8900
material assign Pennant
add mesh cube --name Pole1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.0800 0.0800 1.0500
apply --scale
translate -0.4243 -0.4243 0.5250
material assign Pole
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fin1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1000 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate -0.4243 -0.4243 1.1000
material assign Gold
add mesh cube --name Flag1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2000 0.0500 0.2200
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -135.00
apply --rotation
translate -0.5162 -0.5162 0.8900
material assign Pennant
add mesh cube --name Pole2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.0800 0.0800 1.0500
apply --scale
translate -0.4243 0.4243 0.5250
material assign Pole
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fin2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1000 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate -0.4243 0.4243 1.1000
material assign Gold
add mesh cube --name Flag2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2000 0.0500 0.2200
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -225.00
apply --rotation
translate -0.5162 0.5162 0.8900
material assign Pennant
add mesh cube --name Pole3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.0800 0.0800 1.0500
apply --scale
translate 0.4243 0.4243 0.5250
material assign Pole
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fin3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1000 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.4243 0.4243 1.1000
material assign Gold
add mesh cube --name Flag3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2000 0.0500 0.2200
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -315.00
apply --rotation
translate 0.5162 0.5162 0.8900
material assign Pennant
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.7144 --depth 0.1200 --name Band --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.0600
material assign Gold
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export standard.glb
